Polk County occupies the I-4 corridor between Tampa and Orlando, anchored by Lakeland, Winter Haven and the county seat of Bartow. It has become Florida's dominant logistics market on the strength of that position, with enormous distribution development around Lakeland and Auburndale, while phosphate reclamation land and citrus groves convert to rooftops — the largest single supply of developable land between the two metros.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 31, 2026
